q2_gaps: a non-deictic season time point ("in the late summer of Year 1") — the Time term inventory is Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute plus day-part constants, and seasons are specified only as deictic constants (last_spring / next_summer), so a bare modifier+season expression has no stated encoding
a conveyance PP ("came on a market boat") — whether a vehicle one travels on is the Instrument means/conduit or the entity's own preposition-named oblique (On) is not settled by the roles section

a reciprocal verb taking a bare direct object ("Old Vesh met Coraline Ash") — the collective one-event/multiple-Agent form is stated for coordinated or plural subjects and for comitative "met with", never for a transitive object, which the Thematic-roles test would make a Theme
notes: Names, the capitalized-adjective name rule ("Old Vesh"), the bare capitalized class label ("the Watch" — no Name atom), compound genus, BeforeBy, Source/Goal/CoAgent and the event-coreference of the two "arrived" sentences are all handled correctly. The three gaps above are the only points where the parse had to choose without a rule to point at.
